entries.template: In how many ways can {totalObjects} distinct people stand in a row if one particular person must occupy position {fixedPosition}?
In how many ways can {totalObjects} distinct people stand in a row if one particular person must stand at either end?
In how many ways can {totalObjects} distinct people stand in a row if two particular people must occupy the two end positions, in either order?
In how many ways can {totalObjects} distinct people stand in a row if one particular person is not allowed at either end?
In how many arrangements of {totalObjects} distinct books does book A appear somewhere before book B?
In how many arrangements of {totalObjects} distinct files do three specified files appear in the relative order A before B before C, without needing to be consecutive?
In how many arrangements of {totalObjects} distinct tasks do four specified tasks retain one prescribed relative order, while the other tasks may appear anywhere?
Among {totalObjects} distinct books, A must appear before B and, independently, C must appear before D. In how many arrangements are both order conditions satisfied?
In how many ways can {categoryCount} distinct boys and {categoryCount} distinct girls stand in a row so that boys and girls alternate?
In how many ways can {largeCount} distinct boys and {smallCount} distinct girls stand in a row in strict alternation, where the boys outnumber the girls by one?
In how many ways can {categoryCount} distinct red cards and {categoryCount} distinct blue cards be arranged alternately in a row if a red card must occupy the first position?
In how many ways can {largeCount} distinct men and {smallCount} distinct women stand in a row if no two women are adjacent?
Among {totalObjects} distinct people, {specifiedCount} specified people must be placed so that no two of them are adjacent. How many linear arrangements are possible?
In how many arrangements of {totalObjects} distinct people do the position numbers of two particular people differ by exactly {positionDistance}?
In how many arrangements of {totalObjects} distinct people are there at least {minimumGap} people between two particular people?
In how many arrangements of {totalObjects} distinct books do {specifiedCount} specified books all occupy even-numbered positions?
Among {totalObjects} distinct people, exactly {requiredInClass} of {specifiedCount} specified people must occupy odd-numbered positions. How many arrangements are possible?
For {totalObjects} distinct people, the number of arrangements with exactly \(d\) people between two particular people is {target}. Find \(d\), where \(1 \le d \le 4\).
